replays.replay: The next scheduled ticks write financial-fact payloads under the new ruleset (production-topt-concepts:v4). These ticks are topt_live_pipeline (22:15 UTC production, 22:45 UTC staging) and qqq_live_pipeline (23:20 UTC, production only). They re-read SEC companyfacts. A manual tick within 12 hours of a tick on the old image reuses the old rows unless it sets force_fetch, because reuse keys on parser_version only. strategy_history_projection_pipeline re-projects past cutoffs from stored companyfacts. An environment with a published head (staging.accepted_ruleset_head, kind concept-mapping) keeps the old rules until publish_ruleset(DEFAULT_RULESET) runs there

strategy_history_projection_pipeline re-projects the past cutoffs with the projector code of this release. Launch it by hand on staging after the deploy of this release. Use the run config ops.project_strategy_history_op.config.executed_at set to an ISO 8601 time with a time zone. The scheduled run (20:07 UTC on weekdays) also covers it. History rows are append-only. The old rows stay. The replay adds new rows. The change of #1487 makes the projector skip a financial-fact observation that carries the flag registry_unavailable.

The change of #1518 makes the projector read the primary listing of an issuer through choose_primary_listings (relation primary_listing). An issuer with several listings and no declared primary listing is excluded with reason primary_listing_undeclared. Alphabet reads listing:xnas:googl. strategy_history_projection_pipeline re-projects the past cutoffs with the projector code of this release. Launch it by hand on staging after the deploy of this release. Use the run config ops.project_strategy_history_op.config.executed_at set to an ISO 8601 time with a time zone. The scheduled run (20:07 UTC on weekdays) also covers it. History rows are append-only. The old rows stay. The replay adds new rows. A same-run replay of a cutoff that straddles the deploy reloads a stored snapshot that has no is_primary flag. Alphabet then reads as undeclared on that replay only.
